question: Can the geometry-only exemplar bank be seed-labeled into a usable training and verification asset?
answer: Yes. All 1,959 crops received rows; 1,928 (98.4 percent) labeled with a single codepoint, 685 distinct characters, certainty 1,792 high / 132 medium / 35 low, 10 gateway failures (recorded, resumable design left none unprocessed). The bank reads as a Dunhuang pulse-diagnosis manuscript (top characters 之 103, 以 33, 也 33, 者 29, 脉 28 - classical function-word distribution), and the no-normalization rule held: 脉 (28) and 脈 (17) survive as distinct codepoints.

observations.audit: Visual spot-check of labeled crops by the operator agent: 琴 exact (components legible), 慮 and 無 plausible cursive forms, 隨 plausible with 隋 as the alternative - no gross misreads in the sample; cursive-variant families are exactly what the hardening loop verifies next.

gates.audit: pass (no gross misreads in sample; hardening caveat recorded)

label_status: SEED labels, development-only, never qualification evidence. Hardening path: second-model disagreement review, then expert verification through the draft queue per the gold protocol.
decision_detail: The exemplar bank is now a labeled dataset: 1,928 seed-labeled glyph crops joining the 1,131 blind adjudication verdicts and MTHv2's labeled boxes as the training corpus for the local glyph classifier (the fourth evidence channel and the cheap first stage of adjudication). Classifier training is a separate bounded experiment with its own preflight and GPU budget.
next_permitted_action: Design the classifier-training preflight (data splits, architecture, held-out agreement gate versus the gemini adjudicator) and the label-hardening pass.
